verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cline can run headlessly, run scheduled agents independently of a terminal session, and use isolated local git worktrees through Kanban. It does not document a Cline-provided isolated cloud environment for delegating background tasks. Running inside GitHub Actions or other pipelines relies on the host CI platform's infrastructure, and worktrees are local repository isolation rather than cloud sandboxing, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
